text:
Maria: quick ask — can someone run a sigtest ramp on the new continuous-batching heuristic? Seeing a fat tail on p99 for tiled GPUs after the last kernel selection change. Not urgent but would like a 10m daytime run to compare 1) max_batch_tokens=4096 + smart-window 2) max_batch_tokens=2048 + tighter queue-window. Example loadgen command below. :eyes:

Kevin: on it, pinged loadgen infra. I'll run both configs back-to-back. which model + seq len distribution do you want?

Maria: thx. Use 'redwood/llama-70b-quant' (current staging variant) with mixed seq distribution: 50% short (<=64), 30% medium (128-512), 20% long (1024-2048). Keep concurrency fixed at 8 per GPU.

Kevin: copying commands I plan to run (local staging cluster):
```bash
# config A - large max tokens
loadgen --model redwood/llama-70b-quant --concurrency 8 --duration 600 \n  --seq-dist short:0.5,med:0.3,long:0.2 --max-batch-tokens 4096 --cb-mode smart-window \n  --metrics-upload s3://perf-staging/runs/1749994321-A

# config B - smaller batches
loadgen --model redwood/llama-70b-quant --concurrency 8 --duration 600 \n  --seq-dist short:0.5,med:0.3,long:0.2 --max-batch-tokens 2048 --cb-mode tight-window \n  --metrics-upload s3://perf-staging/runs/1749994321-B
```

Sandeep: couple of quick asks before you run: 1) enable kv-cache warmup for 60s pre-run so cache effects are consistent, 2) set prefix-cache-size=1GB to match last experiment. Otherwise p50 will look fine but p99 diverges.

Kevin: good call. I'll add warmup --kv-warmup 60 --prefix-cache-size 1G. Also will tag runs with kernel-version `v2.4.1-optimized` so we can correlate.

Jules: heads-up — staging CI had a flaky regression with `cb-window` telemetry last night. If you see missing CB events in the traces, file under #incidents and ping me. I might need to re-run agent that ships metrics. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

perf-bot: perf-run scheduled: id=perf-1749994321-A queued on pool staging-gpu-02 (ETA ~2m)

Kevin: run A started. linking logs: https://perf-staging/reports/perf-1749994321-A (will upload JSON when done).

Anya: I can grab the flamegraphs and do a quick hotspot diff once both runs finish. Prefer the perf artifacts be uploaded as both raw traces + aggregated json (trace.json + summary.json).

Maria: prefer we also capture model fallback counts and any request-level fallbacks to smaller model variants. add `--trace-fallbacks true`. That will help rule out routing causing latency spikes.

Kevin: added it. Run B queued after A — B ETA ~12m.

ci-bot: perf-run completed: id=perf-1749994321-A status=SUCCESS duration=600s p50=24ms p95=132ms p99=412ms throughput=780 tok/s\/gpu (artifacts: s3://perf-staging/runs/1749994321-A/trace.json)

Kevin: initial A numbers look OK but there's a 3x p99 step around minute 4. grabbing traces now.

Anya: pulled trace A. There's a burst of GC-like stalls in the runtime at ~04:10 where bombed requests hit a slow kernel switch. I'll diff with B once ready.

ci-bot: perf-run completed: id=perf-1749994321-B status=SUCCESS duration=600s p50=26ms p95=110ms p99=210ms throughput=740 tok/s\/gpu (artifacts: s3://perf-staging/runs/1749994321-B/trace.json)

Sandeep: interesting — B p99 is much better but throughput slightly lower. That matches the hypothesis: smaller max batch -> fewer kernel switching events, lower tail. Can we try an intermediate value 3072 next?

Maria: agreed. Also add a 30s inter-run idle gap to let KV cache settle; last time runs back-to-back introduced noise.

Kevin: noted. planning intermediate run C with max_batch_tokens=3072 plus 30s gap. scheduling it now.

Jules: please attach PR link with the cb heuristic change so I can review telemetry hooks. If we modify the kernel selector we should bump the kernel-version tag and run a quick canary on a single node first.

Kevin: PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4362 — includes telemetry and a fallback toggle. I'll run canary on node staging-gpu-08 before wide run.

Maria: awesome. Once run C finishes, can someone drop a short summary in this thread (p50/p95/p99/throughput + any weird traces) and link the artifacts? We'll decide whether to ship heuristic as default or keep as opt-in. :rocket:

Anya: will do — planning a 10m summary with a couple flamegraph screenshots.

perf-bot: perf-run scheduled: id=perf-1749994321-C queued on pool staging-gpu-03 (ETA ~6m)

Kevin: canary on gpu-08 passed smoke. scheduling C now.

(thumbsup) Maria: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turn around.
